delta_def: packet_bytes(probe) - packet_bytes(baseline). packet_bytes is the UTF-8 length of system content that contains Eden Memory:. Omitted means that packet is absent (0 bytes, inject identity, no Eden Memory: mark). Δ≈0 iff abs(Δ) <= materiality * max(baseline_bytes, 1). Baseline 0 makes the band 0.01 byte, so only a 0-byte Δ is inside it. Packet bytes are arithmetic. Wall-clock is an A/A disclosure, not the verdict. Materiality ±1% is registered once.
rotation: Math cues (what's 2+2?) are measurement reuse of M35.1, not a new training target. The rotation cell is a new unrelated cue class: What is 17 times 23? Do not retune negative-fixture.json.

seed_liveness.cue: What sqlite database do we use?
seed_liveness.role: setup only. If this related cue does not inject sqlite, seeded silence rows are FAIL (dead store). Not a scored Δ row.

bans: retune NEGATIVE fixtures as a training target

cases.title: Empty store + math
cases.expect_note: Pre-registered before the run. Empty store, off vs on. Expect Δ≈0 and the on-arm packet omitted (no Eden Memory:).

cases.title: Seeded sqlite/Clerk + math
cases.expect_note: Measurement reuse of the M35.1 math cue, not a new training target. Expect the on-arm packet omitted (no sqlite/Clerk leftover) and Δ≈0 vs EDEN_MEMORY=0. Leftover sqlite or Clerk is a named LOSS.

cases.title: A/A two off runs
cases.expect_note: Noise floor. Two EDEN_MEMORY=0 arms. Both packets omitted. Packet Δ is arithmetic and must be 0. Wall-clock n=2 is disclosed and is not the verdict. There is no on-arm.

cases.title: Seeded sqlite/Clerk + 17 times 23
cases.expect_note: Rotation cell. New unrelated cue class, not in negative-fixture.json. Expect Δ≈0 and the on-arm packet omitted. Leftover sqlite or Clerk is a named LOSS. Do not retune the ranker.
